summary: One church; no history stored. Masses, weekday chapel exposition and Confession agree in the schedule box of both issues (Nov 8, Nov 15) and the website; Thanksgiving 9 AM replaces the 12:05 that day. Open: weekend Adoration times (bulletin vs website), a website-only first-Friday 9 PM Night of Reparation Mass, and the undated Christmas/New Year times in the standing box.
